printed_source_line: Source: Oath & Action, Who Do They Answer To? Systems Atlas V7, repair log of 64 dated rule changes, August 6, 1965 to the November 3, 2026 ballot, United States: federal, state and local. Snapshot of October 15, 2026. Directions are the atlas’s own codes, set out in its coding note; each row cites its own source. One entry, New York City’s 1988 small-donor matching law, rests on a source the atlas did not check.
ledger_row: not needed: Atlas V7, read by script
derivation: Counts of v7-repair-log rows by instrument_group and direction. Agency rule, executive action and executive order group as "Executive or agency action"; municipal ordinance and council funding vote as "Local law or funding vote". The grouping is the studio’s; the instruments are V7’s.
domain_note: 53 of the 64 rows change election, ballot, district or campaign rules, V7 domain D02
